page.overview:
Who is Dija Maker?

A minion of DIO, he confronts the Joestar Group in a hotel during their trip through .

Dija is a man of average build with light-brown skin tone, and dark brown hair and beard. He gives off a calm demeanor, and is usually seen with a mouse wearing a on his shoulder.

His attire mainly consists of a gold-trimmed double layered longcoat with a popped collar. He also a wears a matching bell-boy hat, white gloves, key-shaped earrings, a gold chain and a pair of pointed shoes.

At first glance, Dija appears gentle and polite, but on the inside, he is actually quite sly and cunning. He takes great pride in his stand's ability to kill people without dirtying his hands.
